parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated, unique token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Commodity
parameters.description: The information about the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace purchase order. You do not need to specify this parameter if the service is not listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace or if you use the pay-as-you-go billing method.

parameters.name: ContactGroup
parameters.description: The CloudMonitor alert contact group that receives alerts.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to perform a dry run for the request. The dry run checks for permissions and instance status. Valid values:

- **true**: Sends the request without creating the service instance.

- **false**: Sends the request and creates the service instance after the check is passed.

parameters.name: EnableInstanceOps
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the service instance has the O\&M feature. Valid values:

- **true**: The service instance has the O\&M feature.

- **false**: The service instance does not have the O\&M feature.

parameters.name: EnableUserPrometheus
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to enable Prometheus monitoring. Valid values:

- **true**: Enable.

- **false**: Disable.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the service instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

- It must start with a letter or a digit and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: OperationMetadata
parameters.description: The O\&M configuration.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description:
The parameters for deploying the user instance.

> If the service instance contains deployment region information, you must specify the region in the deployment parameters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).

- ap-southeast-1: Singapore.

parameters.name: ResourceAutoPay
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to automatically deduct the payment from your account balance. Valid values:

- **true**: Enable automatic payment.

- **false**: Disable automatic payment.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description: The service ID.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance to convert to a paid instance.

parameters.name: ServiceVersion
parameters.description: The service version.

parameters.name: SpecificationCode
parameters.description: The commodity specification code.

parameters.name: SpecificationName
parameters.description: The name of the specification package.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The custom tags.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. You must specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates.

parameters.name: TrialType
parameters.description:
The type of the service instance. Valid values:

- **Trial**: The service instance supports trial.

- **NotTrial**: The service instance does not support trial.
